name: hearth-standalone-bootstrap
comment: bootstrap.js's own runtime dependency (used to apply Prisma migrations directly via @libsql/client-wasm's executeMultiple, without needing the prisma CLI/migrate engine — another native binary with the same Android/iOS ABI gap this whole build works around). The build script separately overrides the SERVER bundle's own @libsql/client -> @libsql/client-wasm for the same reason — that override is NOT in this file, it's injected into an isolated copy of the root package.json (see build-standalone-server.sh) so it only affects the mobile build's dependency resolution.
